column1: # The places whose zone is not simply the one the zone boundaries give their
# coordinates, each with its reason and its source (time_zones.place_zone).
# Hand-kept. One row per place of the atlas, keyed on the place's coordinates
# exactly as the atlas gives them, so that a chart saved from the atlas and
# restored by its coordinates is cast as its pick was.
# Columns: geonameid, name, country, lat, lon (GeoNames' record, as the atlas
# holds it); derived_zone (what the zone boundaries give the point) and
# geonames_zone (GeoNames' own zone for the place), both kept as a record of
# the sources; rule, zone, reason, source.
#   rule geonames   the place is cast in GeoNames' zone (zone);
#   rule kept       the place is cast in the derived zone (zone), as a listed
#                   exception to the rule that would change it;
#   rule unsettled  a Standard-time cast is refused: the sources leave the
#                   clock open; zone names the two clocks the refusal names;
#   rule area:NAME  the area rule NAME of time_zones.PLACE_ZONE_AREAS decides
#                   by the moment; zone is the zone it casts in when it casts.
